2: For the music director, according to The Lilies. A testimony. Of Asaph. A psalm. Give ear, O shepherd of Israel, who leads Joseph like a flock. Shine forth, you who sits enthroned above the cherubim.
3: Before Ephraim, Benjamin, and Manasseh, stir up your power and come for our salvation.
4: O God, restore us, and cause your face to shine that we may be saved.
5: O Yahweh God of hosts, ⌞how long will you be angry⌟ against the prayer of your people?
6: You have fed them the bread of tears; you have given them tears to drink in full measure.
7: You have made us an object of strife to our neighbors, and our enemies mock among themselves.
8: O God of hosts, restore us and cause your face to shine that we may be saved.
9: You uprooted a vine from Egypt; you drove out the nations and planted it.
10: You prepared a place before it, and ⌞it took deep root⌟ and filled the land.
11: The mountains were covered with its shade, and the mighty cedars with its boughs.
12: It spread its branches to the sea and its shoots to the river.
13: Why have you broken down its walls, so that all who pass on the road pluck fruit from it?
14: Swine from the forests devour it and creatures of the field feed on it.
15: Please return, O God of hosts. Observe from heaven and see, and pay attention to this vine,
16: even the stalk that your right hand planted, and concerning the shoot you strengthened for yourself.
17: It is burned with fire, cut down. They perish at the rebuke of your face.
18: Let your hand be on the man of your right hand, on the son of humankind whom you made strong for yourself.
19: Then we will not turn back from you. Restore us to life, and we will proclaim your name.
20: O Yahweh God of hosts, restore us; cause your face to shine that we may be saved.
